none: PAS NLM-B62643: Roman Coin: possibly a Dupondius of Nerva
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Possibly a Dupondius of Nerva (96-98), Reece period 5. Obverse description: Bust right, possibly with crown or head dress. Obverse inscription: [--]SNERV[--]V[--]. Reverse description: Unclear. Reverse inscription: possibly [--]IA[--]O[--]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this corroded and pitted coin, which is chipped. Diameter: 27.4mm, Weight: 7.62gms
